blocks.text: Being sassy and outspoken are among the traits that may be perennially attached to the name of Diamond Star Maricel Soriano, but the veteran star recently bared what she feared most despite her fearless public persona. At the recent pocket interview with reporters for her movie “Haunted Carnival,” Soriano was asked about her greatest fears as a mother, as a woman and as a celebrity. Of the three, the three-time 2026 Best Actress awardee became pensive when answering the question pertaining to her career. “Paano kung ayaw na nila sa akin? Yun ang fear ko.
